subject: URGENT: Your GCET Online Banking Access Suspended
body:
Dear GCET Online Banking Customer, 
We have detected unusual activity on your account and, as a precaution, have temporarily suspended your access. 
Please verify your identity immediately to avoid permanent suspension: 
Verify Now 
If you do not verify within 24 hours, your account will be locked. 
Thank you for banking with us. 
Sincerely,
The GCET Banking Team 

Bank of GCET, 123 Campus Drive, Muscat, Oman
